root_cause: The interactive business-context feedback workspace merged to main, while Netlify production still identified the previous exact source SHA. The canonical Production Source Snapshot transport must be triggered for an exact-source production deployment.
prevention_rule: Material Portal UI changes must not be called live after merge alone. Trigger the existing Production Source Snapshot transport when production identity lags main and require exact current-main commit_ref, ready deploy, Portal DOM readback and Production Release Readback before terminal success.

evidence.outcome: The entrepreneur context feedback workspace is only terminal when the exact current main source is deployed and production readback is green.
